opening.argument: The visible material presents a gift-card promotion: Texas Roadhouse branding accompanies a claimed free $100 card, with “Details Apply” stated in the title. The description links to an external application page, and a frame asks viewers to click the link below. Those are the observable elements of the offer. The sampled frames do not show an undisclosed fee, credential collection, a fake confirmation, or a failed reward claim. The record therefore supports reading this as an ordinary gift-card promotion without assuming an outcome the supplied material does not show.

citations.quote: Get a $100 Gift Card for free. Details Apply.
